about: receipts.bound is the receipts region rendered at the resolution its view names, printed from lane B's readings, resolved(fold): each region's name, count and digest, never recomputed. @0 is the root digest line, at the digest of the @8 bytes the root's store keeps them under. @1 is one line per region, in the byte order of the names: its count as the value, the digest of its set as the place it was read at. @2 and finer is every receipt, with no attest line. Every @0 and @1 line is a wire line built with canonical(), by=bound. A release renders its receipts over the place as the tree folds it, the set a clone reads back from its store, so the tree's @1 and a release's are the same bytes when their receipts are.
